Bind an exact height parameter to the generated box Z extent while leaving the observed X and Y extents unchanged.
Bind an exact width parameter to the generated box X extent while preserving the accepted height binding and observed Y extent.
Bind an exact length parameter to the generated box Y extent while preserving the accepted width and height bindings.
Bind an exact depth parameter to the generated box Y extent while preserving the accepted width and height bindings.
Recognize exact cylindrical bodies with a radius parameter and regenerate their circular profile from that parameter.
Recognize a centered Z-axis through-hole in a rectangular body and regenerate its cut from the hole_radius parameter.

Recognize exact cylindrical bodies with a diameter parameter and regenerate their circular profile at half that diameter.
